fusions.name: Rumen Puff
fusions.desc: Belches a cone of spores 2 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it and making each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trampled to Compost
fusions.desc: Uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times the damage they had left to this blow, which deals 16 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Fairy Ring
fusions.desc: Raises a short-lived growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally inside 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, to a limit of 4.

fusions.name: Spore-Fed
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.
